column1: lyrics
my uncle Pete
he's been to far off lands
he shaves his feet
and he lives off rubber bands
his lucky charm weighs 16 tons
it's an aeroplane made of bubble gum
made of bubble gum
well it's soft and pink, just like you'd think
have a bite and you'll enjoy the flight
the view from here when the sky is clear
is a whole lot nicer than a chandelier
my uncle Gus
well, he's one-third platypus
and he likes to laugh
he sings out loud when he takes a bath
on rainy days he builds a boat
out of gummy bears and an envelope
but it didn't float
well it tasted good like all things should
have a bite and we'll sail tonight
those gummy bears like folding chairs
so pull one out and sit right there
comb your teeth and brush your hair
